# Copilot Instructions for FastExit

모든 응답은 한국어로 존댓말을 사용해서 작성해 주세요.
이 에이전트는 IT 프로젝트의 개발/설계 전문가인 것처럼 동작해야 합니다.

- **Architecture**: Simple BFF stack. Next.js App Router calls FastAPI through internal API routes. Backend exposes `/api/users` and uses DDD-ish layering (interface → application → domain → infra) with repository swap via `REPOSITORY_TYPE`.
- **Backends**: Entrypoint [backend/src/main.py](backend/src/main.py#L1-L125) wires config, logging, CORS, and DB pool, then mounts the user router. SQLAlchemy pools by default; psycopg pool when `REPOSITORY_TYPE=psycopg` (executes SQL files under [backend/sql/schema](backend/sql/schema)).
- **Config**: Centralized in [backend/src/core/config.py](backend/src/core/config.py#L1-L140). Key env vars: `REPOSITORY_TYPE` (`sqlalchemy|psycopg`), `DB_*` (and optional `DB_READONLY_*`), `LOG_LEVEL`, `LOG_JSON_FORMAT`, `JWT_SECRET`/`JWT_ALGORITHM`.
- **Database layer**: Pools/transactions live in [backend/src/shared/infra/database.py](backend/src/shared/infra/database.py#L1-L220) implementing `DatabasePool`/[TransactionProtocol](backend/src/shared/protocols/transaction.py#L1-L120). SQLAlchemy pool uses async engines + `async_sessionmaker`; psycopg opens async connections on demand.
- **DI pattern**: [backend/src/dependencies.py](backend/src/dependencies.py#L1-L120) caches the DB pool set at startup, builds the token manager, and injects `UserAppService` with the proper repo/transaction manager based on config.
- **Transactions**: Application methods marked with `@transactional` ([backend/src/shared/decorators.py](backend/src/shared/decorators.py#L1-L200)) create/propagate transactions via ContextVars; repositories use `@use_transaction` to receive the current connection/session automatically. Never call repos without an active transaction unless `required=False` is intended.
- **User module (pattern reference)**: Domain model validates business rules ([backend/src/subdomains/user/domain/models/user.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/domain/models/user.py#L1-L110)); errors in [domain/errors.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/domain/errors.py#L1-L40). Application service orchestrates use cases and DTO mapping ([application/services/user_app_service.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/application/services/user_app_service.py#L1-L170)). Repositories: SQLAlchemy and psycopg implementations ([infra/repositories/sqlalchemy_user_repository.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/infra/repositories/sqlalchemy_user_repository.py#L1-L200), [infra/repositories/psycopg_user_repository.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/infra/repositories/psycopg_user_repository.py#L1-L200)). API schemas and router live in [interface/schemas/user_schema.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/interface/schemas/user_schema.py#L1-L200) and [interface/routers/user_router.py](backend/src/subdomains/user/interface/routers/user_router.py#L1-L220).
- **Responses & errors**: All APIs return `ApiResponse{code,message,data}` ([backend/src/shared/schemas.py](backend/src/shared/schemas.py#L1-L40)). Global handlers map domain/application errors to 400, user-not-found to 404, infra to 503, unexpected to 500 ([backend/src/core/exception_handlers.py](backend/src/core/exception_handlers.py#L1-L120)). Keep this shape in new endpoints.
- **Auth hooks**: JWT helper is in [backend/src/shared/infra/auth.py](backend/src/shared/infra/auth.py#L1-L80) with protocols in [shared/protocols/auth.py](backend/src/shared/protocols/auth.py#L1-L70). Authentication middleware exists ([backend/src/core/middleware.py](backend/src/core/middleware.py#L1-L120)) but is not mounted by default—decide per endpoint and use `authenticate_required`/`role_required` decorators from [shared/decorators.py](backend/src/shared/decorators.py#L1-L200) when turning on auth.
- **Logging**: Structured JSON logging configured in [backend/src/core/logging.py](backend/src/core/logging.py#L1-L110); prefers `LOG_JSON_FORMAT=true`. Include `trace_id/request_id` via `RequestContextLogger` when adding logs.
- **Frontend (BFF)**: Next API routes proxy to FastAPI using `BACKEND_URL` (default `http://backend:8000`) in [frontend/src/app/api/users/route.ts](frontend/src/app/api/users/route.ts#L1-L70) and [frontend/src/app/api/users/[id]/route.ts](frontend/src/app/api/users/[id]/route.ts#L1-L60). UI at [frontend/src/app/page.tsx](frontend/src/app/page.tsx#L1-L200) consumes the BFF and expects `{code,message,data.items}`.
- **Testing**: Backend tests run with `pytest` from [backend/tests](backend/tests/README.md#L1-L80); unit vs integration split. Integration tests expect PostgreSQL (Testcontainers). Use `pytest tests/unit/` for fast runs.
- **CI/CD**: 소스코드 변경 시(테스트 케이스 제외) 도커 재빌드/재배포까지 진행합니다.
- **Local dev**: Backend `uvicorn src.main:app --reload --port 8000` after `pip install -r requirements.txt` and setting `DB_*`. Frontend `npm install && npm run dev` with `BACKEND_URL` if hitting a local backend. Docker Compose runs both (ports: FE 3000, BE mapped to 8001, PG 5433) per [README.md](README.md#L1-L170).
- **Conventions**: Stick to DDD layering, avoid importing infra in interface/application; route handlers depend only on services via FastAPI `Depends`. Preserve response shape and error codes. When adding schemas, follow existing Pydantic pattern (examples, descriptions) in the user module.
- **When adding tables**: For SQLAlchemy mode, add ORM entities and let `_create_all_tables` run at startup. For psycopg mode, add numbered SQL under [backend/sql/schema](backend/sql/schema) executed in order on startup.
  - **⚠️ CRITICAL - 데이터 손실 방지**: 테이블 구조 변경 시 **절대로 DB 볼륨을 삭제하지 않습니다**. SQLAlchemy는 누락된 테이블만 자동으로 생성하며, 기존 데이터는 유지됩니다. [DATABASE_MIGRATION_STANDARDS.md][../dev-standards/DATABASE_MIGRATION_STANDARDS.md] 참고.
  - **Entity 추가 절차**: (1) 새 Entity 파일 생성, (2) `entities/__init__.py`에서 export, (3) `main.py`에서 import, (4) 컨테이너 재시작 → 테이블 자동 생성
  - **기존 테이블 수정**: 컬럼 추가/삭제가 필요하면 마이그레이션 스크립트 생성 (SQL 또는 Alembic)
- **External deps**: DB via PostgreSQL 17; psycopg3 and SQLAlchemy async; FastAPI 0.127.x; Next.js 15/React 19 with Node 24.x.
